04cfe0cb229809e2a4b9edb78280bca57859c891: Larche is a small-scale resort — 2 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts at all. Larche has kept the identity of an authentic mountain village, far from the concrete resorts of the 1970s. Here, people come for clean air, unspoiled landscapes and a friendly atmosphere that stands apart from the industrialisation of skiing in some large ski areas. Larche's altitude (1700 m at the base, 2200 m at the top) allows it to maintain decent snow cover in mid-winter. January and February are the most reliable; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. With a day lift pass at just 18€, Larche is one of the most affordable destinations in France. For families on a tight budget or skiers who want to make the most of their days without breaking the bank, it is a sincere and often overlooked choice. In short: Larche does not compete with the giants of skiing and makes no such claim. It is an honest, often underrated destination that deserves to be (re)discovered.

04f28a88e8b660654412f3fbab7e87e73019449c: A resort on a human scale, Piau-Engaly relies on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 65 km of runs are well suited to a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Piau-Engaly's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Pyrenees for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2,500 m and a village at 1,850 m, Piau-Engaly's snow cover is generally reliable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause strain early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly with the first serious snowfalls. At €44, the day lift pass places Piau-Engaly among the mid-range resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Piau-Engaly keeps its promises. A Pyrenean resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
